import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, log_loss
import lightgbm as lgb
import warnings
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set directories
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)
os.makedirs("./working", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading training data...")
train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
print(f"Training data shape: {train_df.shape}")

print("\nLoading test data...")
test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))
print(f"Test data shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Test columns: {test_df.columns.tolist()}")

# Save original test_df with Id before any modifications (solution_v3 pattern)
test_df_original = test_df.copy()
print(f"Test_df original has 'Id' column: {'Id' in test_df.columns}")

# Check column names
print(f"\nTrain columns: {train_df.columns.tolist()}")

# Identify feature columns
feature_cols = [col for col in train_df.columns if col != "Id" and col != "Cover_Type"]
target_col = "Cover_Type"

# Prepare training data - make copies as needed
X_train = train_df[feature_cols].copy()
y_train = train_df[target_col].copy()

# Fill missing values with median
print(f"\nMissing values in train: {X_train.isnull().sum().sum()}")
X_train = X_train.fillna(X_train.median())

# Prepare test features from original copy (solution_v3 pattern)
X_test = test_df_original[feature_cols].copy()
X_test = X_test.fillna(X_test.median())

# CRITICAL FIX: Convert 1-indexed labels to 0-indexed for LightGBM multiclass
y_train = y_train - 1
num_classes = train_df[target_col].nunique()
print(f"\nNumber of classes: {num_classes}")
print(f"Label range after conversion: [{y_train.min()}, {y_train.max()}]")

# Create hold-out validation split - NON-STRATIFIED to handle rare class 5
val_size = 0.1
X_train_part, X_val, y_train_part, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=val_size, random_state=42, stratify=None
)

print(f"\nAfter split:")
print(f"Train portion shape: {X_train_part.shape}")
print(f"Validation portion shape: {X_val.shape}")
print(f"Validation target unique values: {np.unique(y_val)}")
print(f"Validation value counts:\n{pd.Series(y_val).value_counts().sort_index()}")

# OPTIMIZED LightGBM parameter configuration (from solution_v2)
lgb_params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": num_classes,
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "max_depth": 8,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
    "force_row_wise": True,
    "min_data_in_leaf": 50,
}

# Create LightGBM datasets
train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_train_part, label=y_train_part)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

print("\nTraining LightGBM model...")
start_time = time.time()
model = lgb.train(
    lgb_params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=200,  # Compromise: higher than v2's 100, lower than v3's 500
    valid_sets=[train_data, val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(20, verbose=False)],
)
train_time = time.time() - start_time
print(f"Training completed in {train_time:.2f} seconds")

# Validate on hold-out set
print("\nValidating on hold-out set...")
val_pred_proba = model.predict(X_val, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
val_pred = val_pred_proba.argmax(axis=1)
validation_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation accuracy (hold-out): {validation_accuracy:.6f}")

# FIX: Use sklearn log_loss instead of broken model.valid_sets access
y_val_for_logloss = y_val.astype(int)
validation_logloss = log_loss(
    y_val_for_logloss, val_pred_proba, labels=range(num_classes)
)
print(f"Validation log loss: {validation_logloss:.6f}")

# Save validation metrics for audit
with open("./working/valid_metrics.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(f"Validation accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"Validation log loss: {validation_logloss:.6f}\n")
    f.write(f"Best iteration: {model.best_iteration}\n")

# Prepare test predictions
print("\nPreparing test predictions...")
X_test = test_df_original[feature_cols].copy()

# Ensure test has same columns as training in same order
X_test = X_test[X_train_part.columns]

test_pred_proba = model.predict(X_test, num_iteration=model.best_iteration)
test_pred = test_pred_proba.argmax(axis=1)

# Convert predictions back to 1-indexed for submission (0-6 -> 1-7)
test_pred = test_pred + 1

# CRITICAL FIX: Use preserved test_df_original["Id"] for submission
print("\nCreating submission...")
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_df_original["Id"], "Cover_Type": test_pred})

# Save submission - preserve exact format from previous solution
submission.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, 'submission.csv')}")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(
    f"Submission Cover_Type unique values: {sorted(submission['Cover_Type'].unique())}"
)
print(f"Submission Id range: [{submission['Id'].min()}, {submission['Id'].max()}]")
print(f"Submission preview:\n{submission.head()}")

# Final summary
print("\n" + "=" * 50)
print("SOLUTION SUMMARY")
print("=" * 50)
print(f"Train data rows: {train_df.shape[0]}")
print(f"Test data rows: {test_df.shape[0]}")
print(f"Number of features: {len(feature_cols)}")
print(f"Number of classes: {num_classes}")
print(f"Validation accuracy (hold-out): {validation_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"Submission file: {os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, 'submission.csv')}")
print("=" * 50)

# Print the official evaluation metric (multi-class classification accuracy)
print(
    f"\nOFFICIAL EVALUATION METRIC - Multi-class Classification Accuracy: {validation_accuracy:.6f}"
)
